jobs.title: Head of Corporate Clients
jobs.description: We are looking for a commercially minded and relationship-driven leader to help lead the next phase of growth of our corporate client business. This is an opportunity to take on an important leadership role with meaningful impact, combining business development, client leadership and the opportunity to shape how a regulated digital asset banking platform serves a fast-evolving market. As Head of Corporate Clients, you will work with leading digital asset companies and help deepen Sygnum’s position as a trusted partner for corporate clients. You will lead a high-performing team, build trusted client relationships and contribute to the continued growth of a business at the intersection of banking and digital assets. Your main responsibilities: - Own and grow Sygnum’s corporate client business across key client segments, and help shape our market positioning across the digital asset ecosystem, including crypto foundations, DLT projects and other crypto-native institutions - Lead, mentor and scale a high-performing corporate client team across sales, client coverage and solutions - Develop and execute the corporate client strategy in close partnership with the Chief Clients Officer - Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across key clients and prospects in Switzerland and across Sygnum’s international footprint - Work closely with Asset Management, custody, lending and trading teams to deliver the best possible solutions for corporate clients - Ensure alignment with FINMA requirements and Sygnum’s risk and compliance framework, while championing a trusted and well-governed approach to digital asset banking - Represent Sygnum at relevant industry forums, conferences and regulatory engagements in the digital asset space - Lead and further strengthen the client onboarding process in close collaboration with internal stakeholders, including Compliance and Operations - Use AI-enabled insights, such as client intelligence and pipeline analytics, to prioritise outreach, improve coverage quality and scale personalised client engagement - Stay close to market, product and regulatory developments, and build a strong network across the digital asset ecosystem - 10+ years of experience in corporate banking, ideally gained within a Swiss-regulated bank or a major international financial institution - A strong track record of building and managing corporate client relationships with measurable commercial impact. Previous people leadership experience with Relationship Managers and Assistant Relationship Managers would be an advantage - Strong understanding of digital assets and blockchain, or the curiosity and drive to build this expertise quickly - An established network and strong relationships across the digital assets ecosystem would be a strong advantage - Solid familiarity with Swiss banking regulation, including FINMA requirements and AML/KYC standards relevant to corporate client relationships - Strong interpersonal credibility and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders across crypto-native organisations - Comfortable using AI and data-driven insights to support client development, research and decision-making - An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing, innovation-led environment - Fluency in English is essential; German and/or French would be an advantage. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include: - Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme - Flexible/Work-At-Home policies - Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs - One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment This role offers the opportunity to contribute to one of the most established regulated platforms in digital assets, working with sophisticated clients at the intersection of traditional finance and the digital asset economy. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

descriptionByLocale.it: Siamo alla ricerca di un leader di mentalità commerciale e di rapporto-driven per aiutare a guidare la prossima fase di crescita del nostro business cliente aziendale. Questa è un'opportunità per assumere un ruolo di leadership importante con un impatto significativo, combinando lo sviluppo aziendale, la leadership dei clienti e l'opportunità di plasmare come una piattaforma di asset banking digitale regolamentata serve un mercato in rapida evoluzione. Come responsabile dei clienti aziendali, lavorerai con le principali società di asset digitali e aiuterai ad approfondire la posizione di Sygnum come partner affidabile per i clienti aziendali. Condurrai un team altamente performante, costruirai relazioni con i clienti affidabili e contribuirai alla continua crescita di un business all'incrocio tra attività bancarie e digitali. Responsabilità dei clienti principali: - Promuovere e crescere il business dei clienti aziendali di Sygnum attraverso i segmenti dei clienti chiave, e contribuire a plasmare il nostro posizionamento di mercato attraverso l’ecosistema delle risorse digitali, tra cui le fondazioni criptologiche, i progetti DLT e le altre istituzioni cripto-native - Leader, mentore e scalare un team di clienti aziendale di alto rendimento attraverso le vendite, la copertura clienti e le soluzioni Esperienza di leadership delle persone precedenti con Relationship Manager e Assistant Relationship Managers sarebbe un vantaggio - Una forte comprensione dei beni digitali e blockchain, o la curiosità e la spinta a costruire rapidamente questa esperienza - Una rete consolidata e forti relazioni tra l'ecosistema dei beni digitali sarebbero un forte vantaggio - Solida familiarità con la regolamentazione bancaria svizzera, compresi i requisiti FINMA e gli standard AML/KYC rilevanti per le relazioni con i clienti aziendali - Forte credibilità interpersonale e la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder senior attraverso le organizzazioni cripto-native - Confortevole utilizzo di AI e informazioni basate sui dati per supportare lo sviluppo dei clienti, la ricerca e il processo decisionale - Una mentalità imprenditoriale e la capacità di operare efficacemente in un ambiente in rapida crescita, orientato all'innovazione - la fluidità in inglese è essenziale; tedesco e/o francese sarebbe un vantaggio. Sygnum offre un pacchetto completo di vantaggi per tutti i membri del team. Essi includono: - Combinazione attraente di stipendi di mercato e di incentivazione imprenditoriale - Politiche flessibili/lavoro-a casa - Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy - Un mese completamente pagato sabbatico dopo cinque anni di lavoro continuo Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di contribuire a una delle piattaforme regolamentate più stabilite nei beni digitali, lavorando con clienti sofisticati all'intersezione della finanza tradizionale e dell'economia di asset digitale. Unirsi a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. Accanto alla nostra ambiziosa missione a lungo termine, ci uniamo anche per raggiungere importanti pietre miliari e anniversari cripto-industriali annuali come Bitcoin Pizza Day e celebrare regolarmente insieme a eventi aziendali a tema come parte del nostro viaggio per formare Future Finance. Se siete appassionati del potenziale di blockchain per modellare Future Finance e il vostro profilo è una buona misura per questa posizione, si prega di inviare il vostro CV oggi!

titleByLocale.fr: Leader de la croissance / Premier vice-président B2B

jobs.description:
Are you a people person? Do you have a strong interest in business development and sales? Do you want to build and maintain trusted client relationships in the digital asset space and help transform the future of finance? If this sounds like you, we have the perfect role for you. Role scope: Enable the B2B (Bank-to-Bank) team to retain and broader its leadership in digital assets by giving the world's largest banks regulated access to digital assets. Wear three hats simultaneously across the full lifecycle of the client relationship — acquisition, integration and growth – leveraging competencies in key account/relationship management, project management and product development. Drive growth by helping lead the team's expansion across markets, product categories and use cases, adapting to competitive pressure and market change. Business development & acquisition:
• Drive business development and pipeline management, sourcing and acquiring new banking partners across international markets – with a focus on our existing licensing footprint (Switzerland, Europe) and opportunities in new, untapped markets – including a dedicated bridge into Middle East and Asia to coordinate acquisition efforts with local teams.
• Drive sales activity along the full acquisition funnel: strategic networking and industry engagement, pitching, RFI/RFP responses, deep dives, and commercial/legal discussions.
• Contribute to strategic projects related to internationalisation and acquisition strategy, including scoping the Target Operating Model (TOM) based on licensing, client stickiness and upselling opportunities. Client & relationship management:
• Lead the end-to-end client journey – from initial contact and onboarding (working closely with Legal & Compliance, Operations and external partners) through to ongoing account management and daily operational support (fiat/digital asset transactions, trading orders, loans, contract amendments, complaint resolution).
• Provide RM support with flexible resource allocation across the client base, progressively learning to cover all stages of the customer lifecycle alongside our Relationship Managers.
• Grow the client business by expanding our digital asset offering (e.g. new tokens, DeFi products, Crypto Compliance Services) and designing bespoke proposals in collaboration with teams such as Asset Management and Trading. Product & internal collaboration:
• Interact with topic experts and Project/Product Managers to support and productize institutional requirements (e.g. API connectivity, institutional DLT services) and drive integration and product development for banking partners.
• Maintain, update and improve internal tools (Core Banking System, ticketing platform, CRM) to ensure efficient operations and accurate record-keeping. Market expertise & network:
• Stay at the forefront of the crypto market and broader DLT landscape – deeply understanding Sygnum's offering and competitive strengths, regulatory developments and digital asset trends – while building and maintaining a strong institutional and professional network through conferences and industry engagement.
• Partner with partner banks and ecosystem providers to create a world-class offering for banking clients while acting as the sole counterparty for our clients.
• Represent Sygnum at industry/ecosystem events to drive Sales, Business Developments and to engage in thought leadership with senior peers, stakeholders and future clients.
• BSc/BA in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. MSc/MBA/CFA is a plus.
• 5+ years of proven experience in client servicing or relationship management with private and/or institutional clients.
• Solid understanding of digital assets and DLT and the institutional crypto landscape (custody, trading, staking, tokenization), combined with working knowledge of the relevant regulatory frameworks (MiCAR, the Swiss DLT Act and FINMA/EU regimes)
• Proven track record of Product Management / Project Management career experience and competences within high-tech industries
• Demonstrable credentials of driving business growth with a hunter mentality, combining a strong sales mindset with a results-oriented approach to winning and expanding client relationships.
• An established network across banks, financial intermediaries and the broader financial ecosystem, with a demonstrated ability to open doors and convert relationships into commercial opportunities.
• Hands-on experience with client onboarding (both private individuals and legal entities), including a strong understanding of European banking regulations and the AMLD compliance framework.
• Combination of consultative and analytical skills, with meticulous attention to detail and a proactive, hands-on approach.
• Ability to work independently and effectively collaborate with cross-location teams.
• Excellent communication skills (spoken and written) in English. German language is a plus.
• Excellent organisational and prioritisation abilities to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously.
• Valid Swiss/EU work authorisation and availability to work on-site at least 3 days per week is a must. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei una persona del popolo? Hai un forte interesse per lo sviluppo e le vendite di business? Vuoi costruire e mantenere le relazioni con i clienti affidabili nello spazio asset digitale e contribuire a trasformare il futuro della finanza? Se questo suona come te, abbiamo il ruolo perfetto per te. Scopo del ruolo: Abilitare il team B2B (Bank-to-Bank) di mantenere e ampliare la sua leadership nei beni digitali dando alle banche più grandi del mondo l'accesso regolamentato ai beni digitali. Indossare tre cappelli simultaneamente attraverso il ciclo di vita completo del rapporto cliente — acquisizione, integrazione e crescita – sfruttando le competenze in chiave di gestione account / reportship, gestione del progetto e sviluppo del prodotto. Aumentare la crescita aiutando a guidare l'espansione del team su mercati, categorie di prodotti e casi di utilizzo, adeguandosi alla pressione competitiva e al cambiamento di mercato. Sviluppo aziendale e acquisizione:
• Incoraggiare lo sviluppo aziendale e la gestione delle pipeline, sourcing e l'acquisizione di nuovi partner bancari in tutti i mercati internazionali – con un focus sulla nostra attuale impronta di licensing (Svizzera, Europa) e le opportunità nei nuovi mercati non sfruttati – tra cui un ponte dedicato in Medio Oriente e Asia per coordinare gli sforzi di acquisizione con i team locali.
• Attività di vendita di unità lungo l'imbuto di acquisizione completa: networking strategico e impegno del settore, pitching, risposte RFI/RFP, immersioni profonde e discussioni commerciali/legali.
• Contribuire a progetti strategici relativi alla strategia di internazionalizzazione e acquisizione, tra cui scoping the Target Operating Model (TOM) basato su licenze, appiccicosi e opportunità di upselling. Gestione clienti e relazioni:
• Condurre il viaggio cliente end-to-end – dal contatto iniziale e dall'imbarco (lavorando a stretto contatto con Legal & Compliance, Operazioni e partner esterni) attraverso la gestione del conto in corso e il supporto operativo quotidiano (cooperazione di asset fiat/digital, ordini di trading, prestiti, modifiche contrattuali, risoluzione dei reclami).
• Fornisci supporto RM con assegnazione flessibile delle risorse attraverso la base del cliente, imparando progressivamente a coprire tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita del cliente insieme ai nostri Relationship Manager.
• Crescere il business client espandendo la nostra offerta di asset digitali (ad esempio nuovi gettoni, prodotti DeFi, Crypto Compliance Services) e progettando proposte su misura in collaborazione con team come Asset Management e Trading. Prodotti e collaborazione interna:
• Interagire con esperti di argomento e Project/Product Manager per supportare e prodottizzare i requisiti istituzionali (ad esempio connettività API, servizi DLT istituzionali) e l'integrazione e lo sviluppo dei prodotti per i partner bancari.
• Mantenere, aggiornare e migliorare gli strumenti interni (Core Banking System, piattaforma di ticketing, CRM) per garantire operazioni efficienti e registrazione accurata. Competenze di mercato e rete:
• Soggiorna all'avanguardia del mercato cripto e del panorama DLT più ampio – profondamente comprensivo dell'offerta di Sygnum e dei punti di forza competitivi, degli sviluppi normativi e delle tendenze degli asset digitali – costruendo e mantenendo una forte rete istituzionale e professionale attraverso conferenze e impegno del settore.
• Partner con banche partner e fornitori di ecosistemi per creare un'offerta di livello mondiale per i clienti bancari, agendo come unica controparte per i nostri clienti.

jobs.description:
As part of the Compliance Framework, Governance, Assurance, Control and Reporting team, this role supports the ongoing development and effective maintenance of the Bank’s compliance and policy framework, ensuring alignment with regulatory developments and emerging best practices. The role is also responsible for coordinating audit-related activities, including audit inquiries, regulatory requests, and the timely remediation of findings. Furthermore, it contributes to the identification, assessment, and implementation of regulatory changes across the organization, supporting the continuous enhancement of the Bank’s compliance, governance, and control environment. Your main responsibilities:
• Manage and maintain the Bank’s policy and compliance framework, ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.
• Monitor and assess regulatory developments and changes, ensuring timely analysis, interpretation and implementation across the organisation.
• Coordinate audit-related activities, including handling audit requests, supporting audit reviews, and ensuring timely remediation and closure of findings.
• Coordinate regulatory requests, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely delivery of information.
• Drive the development and maintenance of compliance risk assessments, ensuring risks are properly identified, assessed, documented and mitigated.
• Manage and perform Internal Control System (ICS) activities, including controls design, testing and ongoing assurance of control effectiveness.
• Support in preparing and managing compliance reporting, including internal reporting and regulatory reporting obligations, ensuring consistency and reliability of reported information.
• Oversee compliance tool management, including the use of digital solutions and AI, to enhance efficiency, automation and overall effectiveness of compliance processes.
• A minimum of five years’ experience in Compliance, with a strong focus on compliance framework management, control assurance, audit coordination, and regulatory engagement, gained within a Swiss or EU financial institution or within audit and consulting functions serving the financial services sector.
• Sound knowledge of applicable regulatory requirements, including the Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA), Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance (AMLO), FINMA Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance (AMLO-FINMA), CDB 20, and relevant FINMA circulars, with particular expertise in governance, risk management, internal controls, and regulatory reporting.
• Experience in regulatory interactions, including the coordination of supervisory requests, preparation of regulatory submissions, and engagement with regulatory authorities.
• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate them into practical, risk-based implementation measures across the organisation.
• Proven experience in the design, implementation, and testing of Internal Control Systems (ICS), including the development of control frameworks, execution of design and operating effectiveness testing, and ongoing assurance activities.
• Demonstrated expertise in compliance risk assessments, audit management, and the coordination of audit activities, including the handling of audit requests, remediation of findings, and timely closure of corrective actions.
• Experience leveraging compliance technologies and digital solutions, with a strong interest in utilising automation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence to enhance compliance processes, controls, and reporting capabilities.
• University degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant professional qualifications and experience.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organisation, including senior management, and confidently navigate complex and challenging discussions.
• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, capable of identifying control gaps, constructively challenging existing practices, and driving pragmatic, sustainable improvements.
• A collaborative team player with a positive and professional attitude, committed to fostering an inclusive, constructive, and high-performing work environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered a significant advantage. • Develop key messages, briefing notes and Q&A, and prepare spokespeople for interviews and media engagements
• Run media monitoring and coverage tracking, with sentiment analysis and share-of-voice
• Report on PR performance and analytics, translating coverage into clear insight and recommendations

• Plan and manage paid social and promotional campaigns
• Conduct competitor analysis and benchmarking to identify opportunities
• Continually optimise performance using analytics to drive sustained growth Integrated marketing & communications: Highly valued is the ability to support broader, integrated communications, including:
• Physical events, webinars and livestreams, social media (paid and organic), digital advertising
• General marketing activities and the ability to support, pick up and deliver a diverse range of projects across the team

jobs.description:
The CEO Office supports Sygnum’s Board of Directors, Group CEO and Group Executive Board on strategic priorities, executive decision-making and company-wide initiatives. As a CEO Office Intern, you will work directly with the Chief of Staff and gain broad exposure to Sygnum’s strategy, operations and senior leadership. You will contribute to executive and Board materials, conduct strategic analyses and help drive cross-functional projects across the organisation. The six-month internship is suited to someone who combines analytical rigour, strong execution skills and an interest in digital assets. Responsibilities
• Support the Group CEO and Chief of Staff in preparing Group Executive Board and Board of Directors meetings
• Participate in key strategic projects that are driven out of the CEO Office, such as international expansion or process improvement initiatives
• Collaborate with other Divisions on critical projects and analyses, for example our Investor Relations, Marketing or People & Talent teams
• Take ownership of selected strategic initiatives and workflows
• Prepare and moderate our internal town hall meetings
• Support the AI Hub in accelerating and scaling AI adoption bank-wide
• You are currently completing or have recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, finance, economics, engineering or a related discipline
• You are an independent thinker who can execute tasks autonomously. This can range from the creation of documents for internal meetings to finding solutions to technical problems together with other departments. We expect you to take the lead and drive things
• You are an open-minded team player. You will work in a position where many endpoints come together. It is vital that you can efficiently collaborate with other teams to further push our goals as a company
• A strong can-do attitude is essential. As a pioneer in the industry, your scope of action will be broad, and we expect you to be willing, and ideally enthusiastic, about tackling the challenges ahead. For some, you may already know the solution; for others, you will need to discover it
• We do not expect extensive prior experience in every topic. However, we expect you to quickly understand unfamiliar subjects and build expertise independently
• You have a genuine interest in digital assets and share our vision for the future of finance
• You use AI tools effectively and responsibly, verify outputs and recognise the importance of confidentiality and data protection
• You are proficient in PowerPoint and comfortable working with Excel, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly, visually and with attention to detail
• You communicate confidently and professionally, both verbally and in writing, in internal meetings and interactions with external partners
• You have a strong analytical mindset and can collect and analyse information, structure complex problems and develop practical solutions
• Direct exposure to Sygnum’s senior leadership and strategic decision-making processes
• Ownership of defined workstreams within strategic, operational and cross-functional initiatives
• Hands-on experience in digital asset banking, financial markets and the regulatory environment
• The opportunity to build a broad internal network across business and corporate functions
• Mentoring, regular feedback and targeted professional development opportunities
• Collaboration with an international, highly skilled and motivated team
• Flexible working arrangements, including work-from-home options
• The opportunity to contribute to the continued development of a regulated digital asset banking group shaping the future of finance Please send us your CV and a concise cover letter explaining your interest in Sygnum and the position. We welcome applications from candidates who may not yet meet every criterion but are convinced they can make a strong contribution to the team. If you have the drive, curiosity and willingness to take ownership, we want to hear from you! Start: December 2026 or June 2027 (Please indicate the preferred start date)

• L'opportunità di costruire un'ampia rete interna attraverso funzioni aziendali e aziendali

• Collaborazione con un team internazionale, altamente qualificato e motivato

jobs.description:
We are looking to enhance our team in Banking Operations with a smart mind that tackles challenges with a hands-on attitude and improvement-oriented mindset. Banking Operations is primarily responsible for the setup and maintenance of static data relating to clients and instruments (incl. cryptos and tokenized assets), the processing of transactions (namely payments, post-trade settlement and clearing) as well as reconciliation and selected regulatory reporting’s. Banking Operations thus contributes to ensuring an optimum customer service, at optimum cost/benefit and risk/benefit relations, by correctly entering relevant data and information into the systems, timely and accurately processing the different types of transactions, ensuring that transaction and position entries are correct, as well as by issuing reports within its scope of responsibility to the relevant stakeholders. We look for someone with broad interests and versatile skills. In this position, you report directly to the Head of Banking Operations Processing, who reports to the Head Banking Operations.
• Ensure smooth client settlement of fiat (e.g. options), and crypto trades
• Reconcile daily balances and positions, and periodic client staking rewards
• Support and manage efficiently daily operations for both fiat and digital assets transactions (Staking, payments & payments investigations, security transfers, Subscription & Redemption of funds etc.)
• Opening and maintaining financial products in the core banking system
• Support the implementation and operational handling of new products and services
• Contribute to continuous quality improvement and risk management of our Financial Services Operations
• Identify tasks that can be automated or improved via Macro, excel, etc
• Support ad hoc administrative tasks whenever required.
• A strong analytical mindset. You need to be able to collect and analyse information and to formulate and solve problems in a structured way.
• A confident appearance in meetings. Be it for an internal meeting, we expect that you can share your views in a professional manner.
• Know your tools. As we work in a business environment, it’s good to visualize things. Hence, you should be capable to create PowerPoint slides by yourself and handle Excel sheets.
• Be willing to learn fast. We do not expect you to have ten years of experience in a field that exists for five. However, we expect you to quickly deep dive into a topic and build expertise by learning from others or by yourself.

For some, you will know the solution, for others, you need to find it. However, as we work as a team, there is no mountain or challenge too big to not be summitted.
• Be an open-minded team player. You will work in a position where many endpoints come together. It is vital that you can efficiently collaborate with other teams to further push our goals as a company.
• Commitment. Readiness to dedicate yourself fully to the role and contribute effectively throughout the 6-month period Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. • Review and harden Infrastructure-as-Code implementations to enable secure cloud deployment patterns and reusable guardrails.

• Partner with SOC and engineering teams to improve detection, alerting, and response capabilities for application-layer threats. You are an experienced technical security expert who can demonstrate the following skills and experience:
• 5-7+ years of deep, hands-on experience in application security or DevSecOps in modern engineering environments .
• Strong experience securing cloud-native architectures (AWS and Azure preferred ) .
